method.backup: Explicit current complete-backup/verify/new-root restore, only within supported product bounds.
method.cache_temperature: Fresh interpreter is not cold disk: OS page cache is retained.
method.corpus: Deterministic retained TXT originals through bounded Catalog/Storage fixture transactions and full integrity audit; not public import throughput.
method.disk_budget: Cooperative measured checkpoint after every 64 imports and at phase boundaries; not a filesystem quota.
method.memory: Whole-process high-water RSS via the unchanged semantic-cache measurement kernel.
method.percentiles: Nearest-rank empirical P50/P95, with actual sample count; no acceptance latency threshold.
method.public_operations: Separate measured public imports, exact retries, refused immutable replacement and checkpoint cancellation/retained-source resume after baseline reads.
method.restart: Build, traversal and restart run in distinct owned interpreter processes.
method.scope: One selected workspace plus a deliberately excluded workspace containing the same query.
method.search: Lexical terms; exact full result/source continuation; ranking remains local to each source window.
method.source_checks: All retained source hashes and catalog identities before/after measurements; quote actions sampled per result page.
method.timeout: Cooperative phase deadline plus a direct-interpreter outer timeout; remaining phases stop on failure.

full_traversal.reason: Full traversal belongs to the previous measured process.

checkpoint_recovery.worker_peak_memory: NOT_MEASURED; phase RSS belongs to the supervising measurement process.

value.profile_scope: Four exact A3 reports: 1000x20, 10000x20 and 50000x20 all phases PASS; 50000x40 build PASS and measure PARTIAL, later phases NOT_RUN; no other-head transfer

limitations: The exact required2M full traversal remains PARTIAL after1,202,800 verified results. Restart, public operations and backup for2M were not run.
The inspector ran on E but the measured application/harness bytes belong only to A3. No E/F corpus qualification transfers.
The four profiles used different AWS/Azure runners; no cross-run or cross-environment performance ratio is asserted.
The1M public-operation timings are only12 bounded samples; synthetic retained-fixture setup is not sustained whole-corpus intake throughput.
The cooperative3600-second phase limit, full fresh search/lookahead/source/copy checks and later-phase requirements remain unchanged.
